messages:
maria: Drafted the release notes for per-route token-level cost insights + rollout controls. PR up at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 — branch `doc/relnotes-route-cost-rollouts`. Need: copy review, SDK snippet updates (Node + Python v2), and known-issues bullets (pinning behavior + streaming truncation).
kai: Thanks — posting here. I'll take node snippets. Can you paste the PR link to the specific files?
maria: Files are under `docs/examples/sdk/v2/` and `docs/content/release-notes/2025-08-route-cost.md`. Note: node examples still use `client.generate()`; we should switch to v2 `chat.create()` pattern. Example quick diff:```js
// old
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'kestrel-1', input: prompt })
// new
const r = await client.chat.create({ model: 'kestrel-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }] })
```
sam: I'll update python examples and add a tiny unit test snippet for the snippet-runner. Any guidance on migration copy?
maria: Add a short note above examples: "If you're migrating from SDK v1, replace `generate()` with `chat.create()` and adjust to the messages array. See code diff." Also add a back-compat note for Dedicated customers.
olivia: Heads-up: staging preview is returning 404 for the relnotes landing page — `/docs/release-notes` -> staging 404. Might be a redirect or build issue.
deploy-bot: Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-789--docs.redwood.ai — build finished, but netlify reported some redirects not applied.
maria: @kai can you also check that the Node snippet has streaming example updated? There's an edge-case in the known issues: streaming truncation for very long system prompts — we should document a workaround.
kai: On it. Quick wording suggestion for the changelog: change "per-route cost breakdown" to "per-route token-level cost insights" — clearer for eng readers. Also I'll remove marketing-y phrasing.
sam: For the streaming truncation known issue, I'll add this mitigation: set `max_system_tokens: 1024` client-side and recommend short system prompts. I'll add this in the Known issues section with a short code note.
maria: Example note to include:```md
### Known issues
- Pinned model routing may return a fallback variant in Dedicated during capacity spikes. Workaround: pin to a model variant and enable reserved capacity.
- Streaming responses may truncate when system prompt + prefix exceed KV-cache limits. Workaround: reduce system prompt size or set `max_system_tokens` in the client.
```
olivia: I can fix the staging redirect — sending small Netlify `_redirects` patch in PR #4570.
kai: Node snippet PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4572. I updated `chat.stream()` example and added a short note about `onDelta` vs final messages.
maria: Nice. @deploy-bot can you re-run the preview after PRs 4567, 4570, 4572 merge? Also run the link checker.
deploy-bot: Rebuild queued for 1755004400. Link checker report (pre-merge): 2 broken anchors found — `#pinned-model-behavior` and `#streaming-edgecases`.
sam: I'll add the anchors and a tiny example test for streaming in `tests/snippets/test_streaming.py`.
maria: Great. Final ask: please keep snippet changes in separate PRs so we can cherry-pick to the 1.3.x docs branch if needed. Once PRs are green I'll do a final pass on copy and tag marketing. Target publish date: next Monday. :thumbsup:
kai: Will do, ping me for review when python is in.
olivia: Redirect patch in PR #4570 is ready.
sam: Python PR up in a few minutes — will link here.
maria: Thanks all — leaving a checklist in the PR description. I'll mark the thread resolved after the final preview is green and the link-checker passes.
